messages.subject: Executive CV | GCC Leadership Mandates | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Dr. Danial,

I am reaching out directly regarding senior executive mandates handled by HiringBooster UAE across the GCC and wider international markets.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership scope spans ESG and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, social performance, compliance coordination, strategic partnerships and executive communications within a large-scale mining environment.

Across 12+ years in multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, I have progressed into director-level leadership at the intersection of international investment, government, regulators, communities and complex industrial operations. I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Leadership, Chief of Staff and VP-track mandates across mining, energy, infrastructure and regulated industries.

I am open to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and wider GCC opportunities, including expatriate, residential and rotational structures. My current three-page executive CV is attached for your consideration. I would value consideration for current or upcoming mandates where institutional leadership, stakeholder strategy and disciplined execution are central to performance.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
